purpose: Hash-bound synthesis of isolated GIVE damage-sector outputs without treating unlike or overlapping estimates as an additive total

aggregation_policy.reason: The two pair-tested rows use incompatible agriculture target contracts; other values are external, regional, explicitly nonadditive, or a mutually exclusive top-down comparator.

rows.scope: global annual-maize rainfall quantity only
rows.blocker: Not a total precipitation-agriculture sector; timing, drought, extremes, other crops, irrigation, and compatibility with the updated agriculture target remain unresolved.

rows.scope: global multi-crop drought, timing, extremes, and irrigation
rows.blocker: The source release explicitly keeps the full precipitation-agriculture SCC gate closed.

rows.scope: global published updated-agriculture GIVE target
rows.value_role: validated same-run additive contribution within its target
rows.blocker: Cross-function uncertainty is case-specific, and the receipt prohibits stacking the precipitation-agriculture result onto this target.

rows.scope: global market component under Blue-SCC settings
rows.blocker: No annual path, matched discounting, direct consumer-plus-producer surplus, or coupled GIVE draws.

rows.scope: global market plus nutrition/nonmarket under Blue-SCC settings
rows.blocker: Nutrition mortality overlap with GIVE is unresolved and the result is not a matched GIVE pulse.

rows.scope: global wildfire-smoke mortality
rows.blocker: No annual draw paths or local reproduction; joint PM health-function and GIVE temperature-mortality overlap gates remain closed.

rows.scope: global meteorological ozone plus nonwildfire PM2.5
rows.blocker: The 2030 source pulse is not harmonized to 2025; mortality overlap, annual paths, and local reproduction are unresolved.

rows.scope: global MimiFUND aggregate water resources
rows.blocker: Not municipal-only; hydrology, uncertainty, and overlap with agriculture and ecosystems remain unresolved.

rows.scope: CONUS Roads plus Rail, Reactive adaptation, 2025-2092
rows.blocker: CONUS-only, truncated support, and cross-sector additivity is not authorized.

rows.scope: CONUS transmission and distribution repair/replacement, Reactive adaptation, 2025-2300; outages excluded
rows.value_role: matched-pulse direct-cost benchmark, not outage reliability welfare
rows.blocker: The released aggregate bundles temperature, rain, lightning, vegetation, wildfire, and coastal-flooding stressors; hazard and infrastructure overlap must be reconciled before addition.

rows.scope: CONUS riverine flood property damage, 2025-2300
rows.blocker: No global coverage; post-2246 values use official endpoint extrapolation and additivity is conditional on exclusion of coastal, transport, and drainage duplicates.

rows.scope: CONUS freshwater recreation willingness to pay, 2025-2092
rows.blocker: No global coverage; freshwater fishing, biodiversity nonuse, and municipal-water overlap remain unresolved.

rows.scope: global biodiversity and ecosystem services
rows.blocker: The implemented evidence supports only a bounded CONUS freshwater-quality endpoint.

rows.scope: CONUS temperature-related property and violent crime, 2025-2300
rows.blocker: Released aggregate valuations cannot remove mortality, injury, labor, enforcement, indirect-cost, and transfer overlap.

rows.scope: global organized armed conflict
rows.blocker: The audited project reports BLOCKED_NO_SCC for organized armed conflict.

rows.scope: CONUS alpine skiing, cross-country skiing, and snowmobiling ticket/entry revenue, 2025-2300
rows.value_role: matched-pulse lost-revenue benchmark, not social welfare
rows.blocker: The endpoint is lost ticket/entry revenue rather than consumer surplus or compensating variation; substitution, producer profit, and national incidence are unidentified.

rows.scope: nonfatal temperature-sensitive emergency-department and hospital morbidity
rows.blocker: No executable fitted response object supports a matched marginal pulse; restricted encounter data and incomplete medical-cost valuation prevent an SCC.

rows.scope: global persistent GDP-growth response in 41 cyclone-affected countries
rows.value_role: difference of published medians, not paired component quantile
rows.blocker: The macro-growth endpoint can embed agriculture, labor, health, infrastructure, migration, and recovery channels already represented elsewhere.

rows.scope: 21-country dengue incidence bridge
rows.blocker: No marginal pulse, monetization layer, global coverage, or independently validated damage path.

rows.scope: global noncoastal migration
rows.blocker: No screened source passes welfare, marginal-pulse, separability, overlap, and reproducibility gates; coastal relocation is already in CIAM.

rows.scope: global-temperature aggregate GDP/productivity response under Bilal and Känzig source settings
rows.value_role: mutually exclusive top-down comparator only; not an omitted-sector residual
rows.blocker: Aggregate GDP/productivity effects can embody many bottom-up sectors and interactions. Units are 2024 international dollars, discounting differs from GIVE, the pulse and climate module differ, the socioeconomic baseline differs, and the damage object is not a sectoral welfare endpoint.

rows.scope: heat-related learning and attendance effects on school days
rows.blocker: No separable welfare or direct-resource valuation, matched marginal school-day climate response, or validated global transfer exists. Lifetime-income conversion is unauthorized and would overlap labor and macro damages; air-conditioning costs can overlap GIVE energy damages.

rows.scope: CONUS CIRA II freshwater angling consumer-surplus scenario NPVs
rows.value_role: original-unit scenario benchmark only; no SCC
rows.blocker: Published outputs are RCP/era scenario NPVs rather than annual matched marginal-pulse paths, and the angling service overlaps FrEDI water-quality recreation willingness to pay.

rows.scope: global GMST-driven permafrost CO2 and CH4 emissions recursively coupled to FaIR
rows.value_role: source-verified feedback-readiness scaffold; no SCC and no scalar uplift
rows.blocker: GIVE emissions baselines have not been verified to exclude permafrost; biogenic CH4 cannot use GIVE's fossil-methane port; matched baseline/pulse recursion and initialization are unvalidated; the PerCX archive has 765 parameter rows versus 775 reported and passes an unused decay argument. The combined EPA 9-50% permafrost-plus-Amazon uplift is prohibited as a permafrost scalar.

rows.scope: global GMST-triggered Amazon forest CO2 release recursively coupled to FaIR
rows.value_role: source-verified feedback-readiness benchmark; no SCC and no scalar uplift
rows.blocker: FaIR's generic temperature-dependent land sink and GIVE baseline land-use emissions have unresolved overlap with explicit Amazon stock loss. META's GMST-only hazard omits precipitation, drought, fire, deforestation, and other interacting drivers; historical conditioning and common-random recursive baseline/pulse behavior are unvalidated. The released noninteger-duration rule overshoots its finite stock, although a tested final-installment correction conserves it. META's 0.1% result and the combined EPA uplift are prohibited as GIVE scalars.

rows.scope: global 16-FUND-region consumer-plus-producer surplus in timber and forest-product markets
rows.value_role: reproduced legacy external market-welfare benchmark; negative value is a benefit
rows.blocker: MimiFUND documentation and executable forestry coefficients conflict; ecological and market calibration is legacy; FUND socioeconomic and climate paths are not rebased to GIVE; and fire, pest, storm, carbon, or other disturbance modules may duplicate forest-stock and productivity changes. The OAT range is diagnostic, not a probability interval.

rows.scope: global climate-sensitive natural-wetland CH4 emissions recursively coupled to FaIR
rows.value_role: source-verified feedback-readiness benchmark; no SCC and no scalar uplift
rows.blocker: GIVE holds natural CH4 at 168.83862060475192 MtCH4/yr from 2015 through 2300, but its wetland share and any replacement-versus-anomaly anchor are unresolved. Biogenic methane cannot inherit fossil oxidation bookkeeping; natural-emissions timing, lagged common-draw recursion, the GMST proxy and reversibility, the 1.05% negative-slope tail, and MAGICC v7.6 versus later-source version alignment remain unvalidated. The Sloughter/MAGICC 30 +/- 13 MtCH4/yr/K slope is a candidate, not an SCC.

rows.scope: Swiss building hail annual average loss under present 2011-2021 weather and a +3C pseudo-global-warming experiment
rows.value_role: original-unit fixed-exposure regional scenario benchmark; no SCC
rows.blocker: The published CHF74 million present and CHF90 million +3C building-hail AAL values imply the reported rounded +22% change under fixed exposure, not annual marginal CO2-pulse damages. Multi-GCM hazard uncertainty, evolving exposure and vulnerability, currency price year, overlap with property/flood/agriculture/transport/grid/adaptation damages, and any global scaling or per-degree linearization remain unresolved.
